caption: The drawing depicts a sleeveless vest with a V-shaped neckline and pointed hem at the bottom center. The vest is light beige or cream in color and features a series of small, evenly spaced floral motifs in pink, yellow, and blue scattered across the main body. The vest is adorned with ten round buttons running down the center front, each encircled by a small decorative ring. The edges of the vest and the inner borders of the button placket are outlined with a thin, purple line. There are two pockets positioned symmetrically near the bottom, each outlined with decorative yellow and purple borders and filled with more intricate floral designs in green, pink, blue, and red. The background of the drawing is plain and uncolored, and the vest is the only object illustrated, presented in a flat, frontal view.
title: Waistcoat
